title: Item Floors

scenario.intro: Visitors ask where an item is kept. The desk knows the vault but not which floor it's on.
scenario.goal: JOIN items with vaults to answer with the floor, and 404 for items that don't exist.

objective: Every item comes back with its vault and floor; unknown ids get a 404.
rules: An id that isn't in the vault answers 404.

hints.text: The floor lives in another table. JOIN puts two tables side by side where a column matches.
FROM items i JOIN vaults v ON v.name = i.vault gives each item its vault's row. fetchone() returns None when nothing matched.
Select i.name, i.vault, v.floor with that JOIN and WHERE i.id = ?; if row is None, raise HTTPException(status_code=404).

dialogue.start: They keep asking which floor. I keep shrugging.
dialogue.success: Item, vault, floor. The visitors stopped wandering.
dialogue.fail: Some answers are missing the floor, or a missing item crashed the desk.
